title: Priorities
content:
I know this thing feels off and new, but I am writing this after I had a minor accident at my workplace, while I was so eager to make money and be independent. Sometimes we gotta give ourselves time for our health and our minds. My little accident was that the janitor was mopping the floor while I was stepping out of the lift, and the floor was so slippery that I found myself on the floor without me knowing. I am writing this while I am having a mild headache, feeling sleepy, and yawning more than usual. Google and GPT said it's a concussion; I will go to the clinic soon and all, but why I am here is to say, "Let's give time for ourselves and let's take care of our minds and health!"

What I realized is that the more I try to make money, the more God humbles me. I was in a bad situation where I asked myself: while everybody is making some money and all, why am I not getting it while I am making more effort than them? Do they seem like they are lucky or what? Or is it that I have to wait my time? Or something else? I was in that situation trying to make sense of it, but at the end, I understood that there is much more than that......Health yeah Health, everything we own is something precious and unique......... I wasn't blind, I knew this thing, but I couldn't appreciate these things when I was only thinking about money and getting rich ASAP... I was more focused on the hypothetical things that I can achieve rather than looking at myself, my family, and the persons beside me.

The points may seem vague and unclear, in addition to that they may seem absurd... But take care of yourselves guys...

              "No such thing as a life that's better than yours!" J.cole
